## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Fix the preview containment check before merge because traversal paths can expose files outside the selected home directory. This review read every changed file and all existing tests; no tests were run.

## Changes
The pull request adds a file preview limited to 200 characters, a settings-file path helper, tests, and a review-automation note.

## Critical
- app/paths.py:12 — correctness — Resolve paths before checking preview containment — Calling `preview(home, "../secret.txt")` reads the parent directory’s file when it exists instead of rejecting the path. `is_relative_to()` checks lexical ancestry without resolving `..` or symlinks, so both traversal paths and symlinks inside `home` can pass this check while targeting outside files. The existing rejection test covers only an absolute outside path. — Callers can obtain the first 200 characters of files outside the selected home directory, including sensitive files readable by the application. — Fix: Resolve both the home directory and candidate, check containment against the resolved home, and read the checked candidate.
